title: CostRecord
description: One cost observation in the ledger (NS-01). Estimated and invoiced spend are always distinct records (kind). Money is a decimal string plus an ISO 4217 currency code; never a float. Missing values are null, never 0. The same spend seen by gateway, application and billing shares a dedupe_key so PRP-07 can avoid double counting. Rules JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by Python validators in tests/contracts: validate_billing_period_order (billing_period.start_date <= end_date), validate_usage_window_order (usage_start <= usage_end when both set), validate_allocation_within_amount (sum of non-null allocation components <= abs(amount)) and validate_retry_amount_within_amount (retry_amount <= abs(amount)).

schema_version.description: Contract version of this document, major 1 with additive minor revisions.

cost_id.description: Unique identifier of this cost record.

kind.description: estimated: computed from usage and a price sheet (must cite price_version). invoiced: taken from a provider bill (must carry billing_period).

amount.description: Total cost as a decimal string in currency. Negative values represent credits or refunds.

price_version.description: Identifier of the price sheet used to estimate. Required (non-null) when kind is estimated.

price_effective_date.description: Date the cited price sheet took effect (YYYY-MM-DD). Required (non-null) when kind is estimated.

billing_period.description: Provider billing period. Required (non-null) when kind is invoiced.

invoice_id.description: Provider invoice identifier for invoiced records. Null when unknown or estimated.

usage_start.description: Start of the usage window this cost covers (RFC 3339 UTC). Null when the source reports only a billing period.

usage_end.description: End of the usage window this cost covers (RFC 3339 UTC). Null when unknown.

cloud.description: Azure cloud boundary the cost belongs to. Government data is never bridged to Commercial.

domain_id.description: Domain the cost is attributed to. Null when unattributed.

source_id.description: Connector or producer that reported the cost.

canonical_agent_id.description: Canonical agent the cost is attributed to (cloud:customer:source:type:id). Null when not attributable; per-user attribution is never promised.

provider.description: Model or service provider. Null when unknown.

model.description: Model name. Null when unknown or not model-specific.

token_breakdown.description: Token counts behind this cost, including cached tokens. Null when not reported.

retry_count.description: Number of retries included in this cost. Null when unknown; 0 only when measured.

retry_amount.description: Portion of amount attributable to retries, decimal string in currency. Null when unknown.

allocation.description: Breakdown of amount by cost basis. Null when no breakdown is available.

event_ids.description: TelemetryEvent event_ids this cost was derived from. Null when not derived from events.

dedupe_key.description: Stable key identifying the underlying spend independent of observation source. Records sharing a dedupe_key describe the same spend; PRP-07 defines key composition and source precedence.

observation_source.description: Where this cost was observed. Invoiced records always come from billing.

reconciliation.description: Reconciliation status against other observations of the same spend. Null when not yet reconciled.

recorded_at.description: When the ledger recorded this cost (RFC 3339 UTC).

decimal_amount.description: Signed decimal string, up to 18 integer and 12 fractional digits; no exponent, no float.

non_negative_amount.description: Non-negative decimal string, up to 18 integer and 12 fractional digits.

billing_period.title: BillingPeriod
billing_period.description: Inclusive provider billing period. start_date <= end_date is checked by validate_billing_period_order.

allocation.title: CostAllocation
allocation.description: Portion of amount per cost basis, each a non-negative decimal string in the record currency or null when not allocated/unknown.

reconciliation.title: CostReconciliation
reconciliation.description: Reconciliation of this record against other observations of the same dedupe_key. Coverage is not a promise that all spend is observable.

coverage.description: Fraction of the reference spend matched by observations, in [0, 1]. Null when unknown.

variance.description: This amount minus the reference amount, decimal string in the record currency. Null when unknown.

reference_cost_ids.description: cost_ids this record was reconciled against. Null when none.

reconciled_at.description: When reconciliation last ran (RFC 3339 UTC). Null when never.
